title: Whose Story Gets Told? Positionality and Bias in LLM Summaries of Life Narratives

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing baseline and explicitly demographic-conditioned LLM summaries of life narrative interviews across racial groups (Black vs. White) using semantic similarity metrics (ROUGE, BERTScore), psychological state lexicons and projections (LIWC, VAD, Stereotype Content Model), thematic extraction shifts, and qualitative expert evaluations for representational stereotypes.

Comparing baseline and explicitly demographic-conditioned LLM summaries of life narrative interviews across gender groups (men vs. women) using semantic similarity metrics (ROUGE, BERTScore), psychological state lexicons and projections (LIWC, VAD, Stereotype Content Model), thematic extraction shifts, and qualitative expert evaluations for representational stereotypes.
